ext.title: Install the WhatsApp extension
ext.what: To send the real product photos into the customer’s WhatsApp chat, with the message, from a computer.
ext.s1: In Pilotix: Confirmation › an order › “Send photos” › “Install the extension”.
ext.s2: Click “Download”: the file pilotix-whatsapp.zip lands in your Downloads.
ext.s3: Right-click the file › “Extract All”. Put the “pilotix-whatsapp” folder in Documents and keep it.
ext.s4: In Chrome, open chrome://extensions and turn on “Developer mode” (top right).
ext.s5: Click “Load unpacked” and choose the “pilotix-whatsapp” folder (the one with manifest.json inside).
ext.s6: Open web.whatsapp.com in the same Chrome and scan the code with your phone (once).
ext.s7: Reload Pilotix: “Send on WhatsApp” puts the photos and the message in the chat. You press Enter.
ext.phone: This video is for a computer. On a phone, nothing to install: just use “Send photos”.
